description.html: This 120x30x60 cm aquarium with 216 liters of volume offers serious space for creating an underwater biotope. A larger volume means more stable water parameters and the option to keep larger fish species.

A large aquarium opens up the possibility of a biotope approach: recreating the natural habitat of the Amazon River, African lakes or Southeast Asia. We recommend an external filter, a CO2 system for plants and quality LED lighting.

If you are looking for non-standard dimensions or have special requirements (reinforced bottom, lid, openings for equipment), contact us. We handmake every aquarium and ship it by courier anywhere in Serbia.
